title: Omarchy PC Build — Hardware Parts List
summary: Complete parts list for the Omarchy desktop PC build, assembled before the end of 2025 with an approximate total paid of ~$1100 USD. Per-part prices are omitted as they no longer reflect real expense; the public build is shared on PCPartPicker. The AM5 system centers on an AMD Ryzen 5 7500F six-core tray CPU cooled by a Thermalright Phantom Spirit 120, a Gigabyte B650M AORUS ELITE AX micro ATX motherboard, 32 GB Kingston FURY Beast DDR5-5200 memory, a 2 TB Crucial P3 Plus PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD, a Zotac Twin Edge OC RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB GPU, a Lian Li A3-mATX case, and a 650 W ADATA XPG CORE Reactor Gold PSU.
entities: Zotac Twin Edge OC GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB

chunks.content:
